name: Earth Stones
overview: The Bible presents earth stones as precious and significant elements created by God, often associated with beauty, value, and divine craftsmanship. From the rich gold and onyx of Havilah (Genesis 2:11-12) to the carefully chosen stones set in the high priest’s garments (Exodus 28:17), and the foundation stones of God's promises adorned with sapphires (Isaiah 54:11), these stones symbolize God's provision and glory. Ezekiel 28:13 further highlights the variety and splendor of precious stones as part of God's original creation, underscoring their role in illustrating His majesty and creative power.
